title: 인천광역시 미추홀구와 연수구의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 인천광역시 미추홀구와 연수구의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 1 (Areas Incorporated into the Jurisdiction of Michuhol-gu, Incheon Metropolitan City) The following lots of land in Okryeon-dong, Yeonsu-gu, Incheon Metropolitan City shall be excluded from the jurisdiction of Yeonsu-gu, Incheon Metropolitan City and incorporated into the jurisdiction of Michuhol-gu, Incheon Metropolitan City:

Lots 63-9, 63-46, 64-3, 64-10 through 64-14, 64-17 through 64-19, 64-22, 64-57, 64-59, 64-66, 64-76, 64-77, 64-79, 69-2, 70-2, 71-1 through 71-13, 73, 74, 75, 75-2, 76-1 through 76-4, 76-18, 76-21 through 76-23, 77, 77-2, 78, 78-1, 78-7, 78-15, 82-1, 82-5, 83-1, 83-2, 83-7, 83-11, 84-3, 84-4, 603-7 through 603-10, 605-3, 605-12 through 605-14, and 605-16 through 605-18.
